descripcion: Objects for games: hiding places for prizes, things that sound when touched, and goals. Some fantastical, for children; some sober, for adults.

estados.jue_rota: Broken: the prizes have fallen out

cofre.descripcion: Wooden chest with iron fittings. The lid creaks open and there may be treasure inside.
cofre.imagen: Footprint of “Treasure chest”: a rectangle with the front corners cut and a notch in the middle, where the clasp is, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

caja_sorpresa.descripcion: Square box with a crank. Open it and a spring jumps out with a boing.
caja_sorpresa.imagen: Footprint of “Jack-in-the-box”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

hucha.descripcion: Earthenware piggy bank the size of a football. Shake it and the coins jingle.
hucha.imagen: Footprint of “Piggy bank”: an oval, 0.30 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Hu”.

mochila.descripcion: Backpack standing on the floor. Soft; the zip goes zzzip when opened.
mochila.imagen: Footprint of “Backpack”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.35 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

caja_juguetes.descripcion: Big plastic box full of toys. Rummage in it and everything rattles.
caja_juguetes.imagen: Footprint of “Toy box”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cj”.

buzon_mensajes.descripcion: Small letterbox on a post, at chest height. There may be a message or a clue inside.
buzon_mensajes.imagen: Footprint of “Message box”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

nido.descripcion: Nest of branches the size of a lorry tyre, on the ground. There may be something among the twigs.
nido.imagen: Footprint of “Giant nest”: a circle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ni”.

olla_arcoiris.nombre: Pot at the end of the rainbow
olla_arcoiris.descripcion: Round, pot-bellied iron cauldron with a lid. Heavy; it rings like a low bell when struck.
olla_arcoiris.imagen: Footprint of “Pot at the end of the rainbow”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Oa”.

campana.descripcion: Bronze bell hanging from an arch, at hand height. Touch it and it rings for a long time.
campana.imagen: Footprint of “Bell”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ca”.

xilofono.descripcion: Xylophone with wooden bars as big as a table, wider at one end than the other. Touch it and a scale plays.
xilofono.imagen: Footprint of “Giant xylophone”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Xi”.

tambor.descripcion: Big standing drum, round, waist high. Strike it: boom, boom.
tambor.imagen: Footprint of “Drum”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

baliza_musical.descripcion: Small post playing a music-box tune non-stop. Heard from afar: use it to mark a place to reach.
baliza_musical.imagen: Footprint of “Musical beacon”: a hexagon, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

carillon.descripcion: Metal tubes hanging at head height. Brush them and they chime. The cane does not find them.
carillon.imagen: Footprint of “Wind chimes”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ca”.

timbre.descripcion: Round metal bell on a pedestal: slap it and it goes ring.
timbre.imagen: Footprint of “Counter bell”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ti”.

arbol_magico.descripcion: A tree with a thick, gnarled trunk whose leaves sound like glass bells. Things can be kept in a hollow in the trunk.
arbol_magico.imagen: Footprint of “Magic tree”: a 7-pointed star, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

tienda_campana.descripcion: Six-sided tent. The fabric gives when touched; the entrance has a zip.
tienda_campana.imagen: Footprint of “Tent”: a hexagon, 2.20 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

casita.descripcion: Wooden playhouse with a pitched roof and a small door. Closed, it is an obstacle; open, you duck to go in.
casita.imagen: Footprint of “Playhouse”: a house-shaped pentagon, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

alfombra_voladora.descripcion: A rug with wavy edges lying on the floor. It does not block the way: step on it and your footsteps go quiet.
alfombra_voladora.aviso: You are on the flying carpet.
alfombra_voladora.imagen: Footprint of “Flying carpet”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 1.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Av”.

fuente_deseos.descripcion: Round stone well with a trickle of water. Drop a coin in and you hear the plop and a sparkle.
fuente_deseos.imagen: Footprint of “Wishing well”: an octagon, 1.40 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Fd”.

estatua.descripcion: Stone statue on a square pedestal. The pedestal comes up to the waist; above it, the figure.
estatua.imagen: Footprint of “Statue”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

seta_gigante.descripcion: Fantasy mushroom: a thick stalk and a wide cap at chest height that you can sit on.
seta_gigante.imagen: Footprint of “Giant mushroom”: a circle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Sg”.

puente.descripcion: Short, narrow wooden bridge. You walk across it: your steps sound hollow.
puente.imagen: Footprint of “Little bridge”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pu”.

charca.descripcion: A shallow pond. It does not block the way, but step in it and you splash.
charca.imagen: Footprint of “Frog pond”: an oval, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

bandera_meta.descripcion: A pole with a flag snapping in the wind. It marks the finish: reach it and you are done.
bandera_meta.imagen: Footprint of “Finish flag”: a circle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

arco_meta.descripcion: Inflatable finish arch: two soft columns at the sides and the way through in the middle.
arco_meta.imagen: Footprint of “Finish arch”: two columns joined by a thin strip on the ground, 3.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

podio.descripcion: A three-box podium: the middle one taller and further forward. You climb on it at the end.
podio.imagen: Footprint of “Podium”: three boxes side by side: the middle one sticks out further forward, 1.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Po”.

globo.descripcion: A balloon on a string, floating at head height. The cane misses it; it squeaks when brushed and pops if squeezed.
globo.imagen: Footprint of “Balloon”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.30 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gl”.

diana.descripcion: Round target on a tripod, at chest height.
diana.imagen: Footprint of “Target”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Di”.

senal_flecha.descripcion: A post with wooden arrows pointing along paths. The arrows are at head height.
senal_flecha.imagen: Footprint of “Signpost with arrows”: a circle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Sf”.

estrella_suelo.descripcion: A star painted on the ground. You cannot feel it underfoot: it marks a point you must pass.
estrella_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Star on the ground”: a 5-pointed star, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

taquilla.descripcion: Tall, narrow metal locker with a lock. You leave your things inside before going in.
taquilla.imagen: Footprint of “Locker”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

caja_fuerte.descripcion: Steel safe, low and very heavy. The dial clicks as it turns and the door gives slowly.
caja_fuerte.imagen: Footprint of “Safe”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

buzon.descripcion: Bank of letterboxes in the entrance hall, hung at chest height. It sticks out only a little; the cane passes under it.
buzon.imagen: Footprint of “Entrance letterbox”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bu”.

paquete.descripcion: Sealed cardboard box left on the floor by a door. Light; it crackles when picked up.
paquete.imagen: Footprint of “Parcel”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

maletin.descripcion: Rigid briefcase on the floor beside a chair. The catches go clack.
maletin.imagen: Footprint of “Briefcase”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

cuenco_llaves.descripcion: Ceramic bowl with a bunch of keys, on a narrow pedestal at hand height.
cuenco_llaves.imagen: Footprint of “Keys in a bowl”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

paraguero.descripcion: Metal umbrella stand by the door with an umbrella in it. Remember to take it when you leave.
paraguero.imagen: Footprint of “Umbrella in the stand”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

percha_abrigo.descripcion: A coat hanging on a wall hook at shoulder height. Soft; it sticks out a hand's width.
percha_abrigo.imagen: Footprint of “Coat on the hook”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.20 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

mesa_objetos.descripcion: Small table with several things on it to recognise by touch: a wallet, a phone, a pair of glasses.
mesa_objetos.imagen: Footprint of “Table of items”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

saco_monedas.descripcion: Cloth sack tied with a cord, fat and heavy. Move it and the coins inside jingle; you can feel the round lumps through the cloth.
saco_monedas.imagen: Footprint of “Sack of coins”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Sm”.

pinata.descripcion: A cardboard and crêpe-paper figure hanging from a rope at head height. You hit it with a stick until it breaks and the sweets and prizes tumble out.
pinata.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging piñata”: a 5-pointed star, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.45 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pi”.

caja_musica.descripcion: Small wooden box with a crank on one side. Lift the lid and a tinkling tune plays and slowly fades; inside there is a cloth-lined hollow.
caja_musica.imagen: Footprint of “Music box”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.18 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

vasija.descripcion: Pot-bellied clay jar, thigh high, with two handles and a narrow mouth. It sounds hollow when tapped and, if you shake it, something rolls about inside.
vasija.imagen: Footprint of “Ancient jar”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Va”.

barril_pirata.descripcion: Wooden barrel of staves bound with iron hoops, waist high. It sounds hollow when struck; the lid lifts off and anything could be inside.
barril_pirata.imagen: Footprint of “Pirate barrel”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

huevo_dragon.descripcion: Huge egg the size of a watermelon, with a hard shell of raised scales. It is warm and, every so often, something stirs inside.
huevo_dragon.imagen: Footprint of “Dragon egg”: an oval, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Hd”.

corona_cojin.descripcion: Narrow waist-high column with a soft cushion on top and, on it, a cold metal crown with points. Its pendants jingle when you lift it.
corona_cojin.imagen: Footprint of “Crown on a cushion”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

gema_pedestal.descripcion: Stone column at chest height with a large gem on top, cold, with smooth faces and sharp edges. Pick it up and a bright chord rings out.
gema_pedestal.imagen: Footprint of “Gem on a pedestal”: a hexagon, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

mapa_tesoro.descripcion: Sloping wooden lectern with a rolled parchment tied with a ribbon. It crackles when unrolled; the path is marked in relief so you can trace it with a finger.
mapa_tesoro.imagen: Footprint of “Treasure map on a lectern”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

botella_mensaje.descripcion: Glass bottle lying on the ground, corked, with a rolled paper inside. Move it and the paper rustles against the glass; it rolls away if nobody holds it.
botella_mensaje.imagen: Footprint of “Message in a bottle”: an oval, 0.10 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

litofono.descripcion: Low wooden table with five stone slabs laid from largest to smallest. Struck with the mallet they ring like dry bells: the big ones low, the small ones high.
litofono.imagen: Footprint of “Stone lithophone”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Li”.

cuerno_caza.descripcion: Curved brass horn hanging from a nail at shoulder height, with a cold mouthpiece at the narrow end. Blow it and a call rings out across the whole castle.
cuerno_caza.imagen: Footprint of “Horn hanging on the wall”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

caracola.descripcion: Large conch, rough outside and smooth and cold inside. Hold it to your ear and you hear the sea and, sometimes, a whispered clue.
caracola.imagen: Footprint of “Talking conch shell”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.30 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

organillo.descripcion: Wooden box on a two-wheeled cart, waist high, with a crank on one side: turn it and a fairground waltz plays. Push it and it rolls.
organillo.imagen: Footprint of “Barrel organ”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Or”.

trono.descripcion: Huge carved wooden chair with broad arms and a back taller than a person, on a one-step dais. You have to climb the step to sit down.
trono.imagen: Footprint of “Throne”: a U open at the front, 1.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

caldero_pociones.descripcion: Iron cauldron on three legs over glowing embers, bubbling non-stop. You feel the heat as you approach: do not touch it. There is a long ladle for stirring.
caldero_pociones.imagen: Footprint of “Potion cauldron over the fire”: a circle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

libro_hechizos.descripcion: Huge, heavy book lying open on a stone lectern, with leather covers and thick pages that crackle. Turn a page and a spell sounds.
libro_hechizos.imagen: Footprint of “Spell book on a lectern”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Lh”.

bola_cristal.nombre: Crystal ball on a small table
bola_cristal.descripcion: Small round table covered with a fringed cloth and, on top, a cold smooth crystal ball on its stand. Cup it in your hands and it hums and whispers.
bola_cristal.imagen: Footprint of “Crystal ball on a small table”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

espada_roca.descripcion: Large rock, knee high, with a sword driven halfway in; the hilt is at chest height. It only comes out once the challenge is won.
espada_roca.imagen: Footprint of “Sword in the stone”: a rock with an irregular outline, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

canon_pirata.descripcion: Long iron cannon on a four-wheeled wooden carriage. The cold barrel sticks out at the front; fire it and the fuse fizzes, it booms and the cannon jerks back.
canon_pirata.imagen: Footprint of “Pirate cannon”: a wide carriage at the back and the long barrel reaching forward, 0.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

timon_barco.descripcion: Wooden ship's wheel with spokes ending in handles, on a stand at chest height. It turns with a wooden clatter and lets you choose a course.
timon_barco.imagen: Footprint of “Ship's wheel”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

consola_nave.descripcion: Curved control desk at waist height, covered in buttons, levers and switches of different shapes that beep when touched. The pilot sits inside the curve.
consola_nave.imagen: Footprint of “Spaceship control console”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 1.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cn”.

escotilla_nave.descripcion: Round, thick metal door in its frame: it beeps twice, hisses as the pressure releases and slides aside. Closed it blocks the way; open, there is a step in the frame.
escotilla_nave.imagen: Footprint of “Spaceship hatch”: two thick jambs at the sides joined by a thin leaf barring the way, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

meteorito.descripcion: Black, porous rock fallen from the sky, in a small crater. It is still hot: it smokes and crackles. Do not touch it until it cools; the crater rim is easy to trip on.
meteorito.imagen: Footprint of “Smoking meteorite”: a rock with an irregular outline, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

dado_gigante.descripcion: Large cube of firm foam with raised dots on each face, from one to six. Roll it, then feel the dots on the top face to count them.
dado_gigante.imagen: Footprint of “Giant die”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Dg”.

rayuela.descripcion: Numbered squares on the ground with a raised cord stuck along their edges, for hopping on one foot. Your foot feels the cord as you pass from square to square.
rayuela.imagen: Footprint of “Raised hopscotch”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

huellas_suelo.descripcion: A trail of raised footprints on the ground (feet, paws or claws) leading somewhere. You feel them through your soles and they crunch underfoot.
huellas_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Footprints on the ground”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Hs”.

llave_magica.descripcion: Large, heavy iron key with an ornate ring, hanging from a hook on a low column. It chimes as you take it: it opens some door or chest.
llave_magica.imagen: Footprint of “Magic key on its hook”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Lm”.

puerta_magica.descripcion: Wooden door with iron fittings and a big lock, in its stone frame, standing in the middle of the path with no wall around it. It opens only with the key; you hear a sparkle as you pass through.
puerta_magica.imagen: Footprint of “Magic door”: two thick jambs at the sides joined by a thin leaf barring the way, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

puerta_secreta.descripcion: Bookcase full of books that, when you pull one particular book, swings round with a creak and reveals a passage behind. From the front it is an ordinary bookcase.
puerta_secreta.imagen: Footprint of “Bookcase with a secret door”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

rastrillo.descripcion: Iron grille at the castle entrance, with thick bars ending in points. Lowered, it bars the way; as it rises the chain creaks and rattles, and it ends up above your head.
rastrillo.imagen: Footprint of “Castle portcullis”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

puente_levadizo.descripcion: Plank bridge over the moat, hanging from two chains. Raised, it is a wooden wall with the moat in front; lowered, you cross it and your steps sound hollow.
puente_levadizo.imagen: Footprint of “Drawbridge”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

palanca.descripcion: Iron lever on the wall at waist height, with a wooden handle. Pull it down or push it up and it clacks, and something moves somewhere else.
palanca.imagen: Footprint of “Wall lever”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

placa_presion.descripcion: Square slab slightly higher than the rest that sinks with a click when stepped on and sets something off: a trap or a door. Your foot feels the joint around it.
placa_presion.aviso: Click: the slab has sunk under your foot.
placa_presion.imagen: Footprint of “Pressure plate”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

panel_simon.descripcion: Wall panel with four large buttons, each with a raised shape (circle, square, triangle and star) and its own note. You must repeat the tune it plays.
panel_simon.imagen: Footprint of “Four-button memory panel”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.15 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ps”.

reloj_arena.descripcion: Hourglass on a stand at waist height: two cold glass bulbs joined at the waist. Turn it over and you hear the sand run for a minute; when it stops, time is up.
reloj_arena.imagen: Footprint of “Giant hourglass”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

portal_magico.descripcion: Two clusters of standing stones, taller than a person, with a gap between them. When active it hums and the air shimmers; walk through and you travel somewhere else. When inactive, a spell seals the gap.
portal_magico.imagen: Footprint of “Magic stone portal”: two clusters of tall stones at the sides and the way through in the middle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

dragon_dormido.descripcion: Enormous dragon curled up asleep, tail wrapped around it. Its scales are hard and warm; it breathes slowly and snores. Touch it and it wakes with a roar.
dragon_dormido.imagen: Footprint of “Sleeping dragon”: a curled-up body, almost round, with the tail wrapped around it, 3.00 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Dd”.

buho_percha.descripcion: Owl on a free-standing wooden perch, its head at chest height. It hoots now and then and, if you ask, gives a clue. Very soft feathers; it does not like being touched.
buho_percha.imagen: Footprint of “Owl on its perch”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

loro_percha.descripcion: Parrot on a T-shaped wooden perch at chest height. It squawks, repeats words and sometimes blurts out where something is hidden.
loro_percha.imagen: Footprint of “Parrot on its perch”: a T shape, 0.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Lp”.

gato_negro.descripcion: A cat sitting or lying on the floor, small and soft. It miaows, purrs if you stroke it and sometimes moves elsewhere: take care not to tread on it.
gato_negro.imagen: Footprint of “Cat”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.25 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gn”.

panal_colgado.nombre: Wild honeycomb hanging from a branch
panal_colgado.descripcion: Wild bees' nest hanging from a branch at head height, teardrop-shaped and rough as paper, buzzing non-stop. Better not touch it: there is honey inside, and bees. The cane misses it; the buzzing does not.
panal_colgado.imagen: Footprint of “Wild honeycomb hanging from a branch”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pc”.

armadura.descripcion: Knight's suit of armour standing on a plinth, holding a lance. Cold, jointed metal: it clanks when struck and the helmet visor lifts up.
armadura.imagen: Footprint of “Suit of armour”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

robot_guia.descripcion: Round robot on wheels, the height of a child. It whirrs as it turns its head, beeps as if talking and leads you to the next challenge. It can move: listen for where it is.
robot_guia.imagen: Footprint of “Guide robot”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Rg”.

muneco_nieve.descripcion: Three-ball snowman, cold and wet, with a carrot nose and two twigs for arms. It crumbles a little when touched and the ground around it is slippery.
muneco_nieve.imagen: Footprint of “Snowman”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mn”.

fantasma.descripcion: Old sheet hanging from the ceiling like a ghost, floating from knee height to above your head. Brush against it and it sways and a wail sounds. The cane passes underneath.
fantasma.imagen: Footprint of “Bedsheet ghost”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Fa”.

telarana.descripcion: Cobweb strung between two trees or two columns, sticky threads from waist height to above your head. The cane does not touch it: you feel it on your face and hands.
telarana.imagen: Footprint of “Giant cobweb”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Te”.

estalactita.descripcion: Cold, wet spike of rock hanging from the cave roof down to head height. It drips constantly: the plink, plink helps you find it, and the floor beneath is slippery.
estalactita.imagen: Footprint of “Stalactite”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Es”.

liana.descripcion: Thick, rough vine hanging from a tree down to knee height; it swings when pushed. Holding on, you can leap across a river or a moat.
liana.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging vine”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, hanging 0.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Li”.

escalera_cuerda.descripcion: Rope ladder with wooden rungs hanging from a branch or a ship's side down to the ground. It sways a lot as you climb and the rungs wobble.
escalera_cuerda.imagen: Footprint of “Rope ladder”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

arenas_movedizas.descripcion: Pool of wet, soft sand where your feet sink and are hard to pull out. It makes a dull squelch. To get out: slowly and backwards.
arenas_movedizas.imagen: Footprint of “Quicksand”: an oval, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

rio_lava.descripcion: River of lava crossing the path: you hear it bubble and crackle and feel the heat on your face several steps away. It cannot be walked on: find a bridge or a vine.
rio_lava.imagen: Footprint of “River of lava”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 1.50 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rl”.

trampilla_suelo.descripcion: Plank trapdoor in the floor with an iron ring to pull. Closed, you walk on it and it sounds hollow; open, it leaves a hole with a ladder leading down.
trampilla_suelo.aviso: Trapdoor: when it is open there is a hole in the floor.
trampilla_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Trapdoor in the floor”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

hilo_cascabeles.descripcion: Taut string across the path at ankle height, with little bells hanging from it: touch it and they jingle and give you away. The cane finds it if you sweep low along the ground.
hilo_cascabeles.imagen: Footprint of “Tripwire with bells”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.03 metres, hanging 0.15 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Hc”.

entrada_cueva.descripcion: Arch of rough, cold rock opening in a stone wall. Inside the air is damp and every sound echoes; you can follow the walls by hand to the back, where something may be hidden.
entrada_cueva.imagen: Footprint of “Cave mouth”: a U open at the front, 3.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

muralla_almenas.descripcion: Thick stone wall, taller than a person, with battlements on top. Follow it by hand: large stones, deep cold joints. A wall to find your way around the castle.
muralla_almenas.imagen: Footprint of “Battlemented wall section”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.
